description:
READ-ONLY feasibility report for migrating Odoo from `source_host` (live) to
    `target_host` (clean). Detects the source version/edition + odoo.conf logical
    settings, finds the custom-addons paths (and flags any it can't locate - you'll
    be asked where they are), sizes the DB + filestore, and verifies the NEW server
    can hold and run it (disk for dump+filestore+restore, RAM for the workers, CPU,
    Postgres major). Returns a pass/warn/fail checklist, a verdict, a `plan_hint`
    (feed it to the new-server provision so version/edition/config match), the
    custom-addons list, and any `questions` for the operator. Touches nothing.
name: migrate_inspect
